newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Multipolar shareholders give nod to Matahari buy.
newsitem.headline: Multipolar shareholders give nod to Matahari buy.

text.p: Indonesia's technology-based services and retail firm PT Multipolar Corp, a unit of the Lippo Group, won shareholders' approval on Thursday to take a 50.1 percent controlling interest in retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima.

Matahari is Indonesia's largest department store operator. Multipolar has the franchises to operate U.S.-based Wal-Mart and J.C. Penney Company Inc in Indonesia. Multipolar's vice-president commissioner Roy Tirtadji said the Lippo Group would in turn like Matahari to have a stake of around around 20 percent in Multipolar.
"From the Lippo side, we would like (Matahari founder) Hari Darmawan to buy a stake of about 20 percent in Multipolar," Tirtadji told journalists after an extraordinary general meeting.
He said this was up to Darmawan himself, but added: "I believe he is also interested in buying a stake in Multipolar as he also believes this alliance will boost Multipolar's performance."
Tirtadji said the EGM approved the purchase of a 45 percent stake in PT Matahari Putra Prima through options.
"Shareholders also approved the firm's plan to buy a 5.1 percent stake in Matahari through a tender offer," he said.
Multipolar will finance the acquisition through its own internal funds and proceeds from an expected rights issue, but Tirtadji declined to give any figures.
"We will decide it later. We have to check on how much funds we have before the rights issue," he said.
Multipolar said in a statement to an analysts' meeting on December 23 it would pay 673 billion rupiah in cash and notes for a 45 percent stake in Matahari.
It said the company would pay 61.88 billion rupiah in cash, 300 billion rupiah in 12-month non-interest bearing notes and 311 billion rupiah in 24-month non-interest bearing notes.
Tirtadji said the acquisition would boost Multipolar's profit in 1997 by a minimum of 400 percent.
He said forecast sales in 1997 would reach two trillion rupiah and expected sales to increase to 15 trillion rupiah within the next 10 years.
